raw_proposal.draft:
Dear [Customer Name],

Thank you for your engagement with Cedar Systems. We understand that there may be some conflicting information regarding the current status of your project. As noted in our records, there was an earlier inquiry about spreadsheet coordination, and the latest call indicates that the project is paused with some disagreement about the requirement.

To ensure we align properly and provide the best support, we would appreciate the opportunity to clarify the current project status and requirements. This will help us better tailor our approach and ensure that we meet your needs effectively.

Please let us know a convenient time to discuss further.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Team
[Contact Information]
questions: What is the current status of the project?
Are there any specific requirements or concerns that need to be addressed?

There is a disagreement about the requirement, which needs to be resolved before proceeding.
